title: Broncos VIP Tent 10/09/11
author: madwire
excerpt: Great turnout for USBank VIP.  Broncos players and cheerleaders stopped by to sign autographs and talk with fans.  Amazing prizes given out including a Champ Bailey jersey.  Great time.
